e.title: FOS（英国金融申诉专员服务）：公开裁决库、案件量与「洞见」出版物
e.title_en: FOS (UK Financial Ombudsman Service): a public decisions database, case volumes and "insight" publications
e.title_hk: FOS（英國金融申訴專員服務）：公開裁決庫、案件量與「洞見」出版物
e.summary: 英国金融申诉专员服务：设有可检索的公开裁决库、按季公布受理案件量，并发布 14 页的「洞见」文章库；实测标题含 2026/27 首季受理 53,600 宗案件
e.summary_en: The UK Financial Ombudsman Service: it runs a searchable public decisions database, publishes case volumes by quarter, and offers a 14-page "insight" article library; a measured page title records 53,600 cases received in the first quarter of 2026/27
e.summary_hk: 英國金融申訴專員服務：設有可檢索的公開裁決庫、按季公布受理案件量，並發布 14 頁的「洞見」文章庫；實測標題含 2026/27 首季受理 53,600 宗案件
e.body:
**FOS（Financial Ombudsman Service，英国金融申诉专员服务）** 是**英国处理金融消费者与机构之间争议的法定申诉机构**，其覆盖范围包含保险。本条目补的是**「争议裁决的公开一手来源」这一形态**：实测池内申诉/争议侧此前**只有一条 [[hk-icb]]（香港保险投诉局，以投诉个案年报数据为主）**，而 **FOS 提供的是「逐案裁决库」而非「汇总年报」**——**这是本条目补上的东西**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页标题实测为 **「Financial Ombudsman Service: Our homepage」**；⭐ **「Ombudsman decisions（申诉专员裁决）」页 `/businesses/resolving-complaint/ombudsman-decisions`，实测 86.4KB，标题「Ombudsman decisions」**——**公开裁决的检索入口**；⭐ **「Our insight」页 `/businesses/resolving-complaint/our-insight`，实测 96.3KB，标题「Our insight | Page 1 of 14」**——**洞见文章库共 14 页**（`/data-insight` 实测解析到同一页，96.3KB）；**「Our business homepage」`/businesses` 实测 88.2KB**；⭐ 实测新闻页标题为 **「Financial Ombudsman received 53,600 cases in the first quarter of 2026/27」**——**按季公布受理案件量，且数字写进标题**；导航实测另含 **How we resolve complaints**、**Our governance and funding**、**Annual reports and accounts**、**Consultations**、**Modernising the redress system**、**Strategic plans and budget**、**Our Board of Directors**、**Our Executive Team**、**Our Ombudsmen**、**Data and insight**、**News**，以及 **case studies（案例）** 栏目。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「争议裁决的一手资料层」**——池内有 [[fca-open-data]]（**监管者公布的机构自报投诉量**，属**监管申报口径**），而 **FOS 公布的是「升级到申诉专员并作出裁决」的案件与理由**，**两者口径不同、不能互相替代**（本词条在此明确写出这一区分，避免读者把二者混为一谈）。**② 「逐案裁决」对做产品条款与理赔争议的学生是可直接用的材料**——**条款怎么写、理赔怎么被拒、裁决怎么站边**，这些在汇总统计里看不到；可与 [[lossratio-r]]、[[health-insurance-reserving-handbook]]、[[insurance-qa-en]]、[[payer-agent-audit]] 并读。**③ 与 [[hk-icb]] 构成「香港 vs 英国」的消费者救济对照**——两地都是保险争议处理机构，但**一个以年报统计为主、一个以逐案裁决库为主**；这对**跨境比较消费者保护强度**的研究是一个具体切入点。**④ 案件量本身是行业观察指标**——**申诉案件量的变化往往先于监管处罚反映产品问题**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面存在、标题、页面体量、导航结构与一处案件量标题**，**但未检索裁决库、未打开任何一份裁决书、未打开任何一期年报或洞见文章**，因此**不能转述任何个案结论、裁决理由或统计口径**；**② 53,600 这一数字来自页面标题实测**，**本次未打开正文核实其统计范围、口径与是否含保险拆分**；**③ 「裁决库是否可全文检索、覆盖年限、是否收费或需登录」本次未核实**；**④** 首页导航中另见一个 **`complaints.financial-ombudsman.org.uk/ombudsman-dashboard` 仪表盘链接**，**该链接本次未打开**，故**本词条不描述其内容**；**⑤** 本次尝试的 `/businesses/complaints-data` **路径返回 404**（**属我猜测的路径错误，非站点问题**）——**故本词条不使用该 URL**；**⑥** 本词条**不主张** FOS 提供精算工具或保险定价数据。**核实说明**：首页（200）、`/businesses`（88.2KB）、`ombudsman-decisions`（86.4KB）、`our-insight`（96.3KB，含「Page 1 of 14」）、`/data-insight`（96.3KB）、案件量新闻页（标题实测）均 HTTP 200 实测；**未检索裁决库、未打开裁决书、年报或洞见文章、未打开仪表盘**。
e.body_en:
**FOS (the Financial Ombudsman Service)** is **the United Kingdom’s statutory dispute-resolution body for financial consumers and firms**, and its remit includes insurance. This entry adds the **"public primary source of decided disputes"** form: the corpus’s complaints and disputes side previously held **only [[hk-icb]] (the Hong Kong Insurance Complaints Bureau, centred on annual complaint statistics)**, whereas **FOS offers "a case-by-case decisions database" rather than "an aggregated annual report"** — **and that is what this entry adds**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage title reads **"Financial Ombudsman Service: Our homepage"**; ⭐ the **"Ombudsman decisions" page `/businesses/resolving-complaint/ombudsman-decisions` measures 86.4KB with the title "Ombudsman decisions"** — **the entry point to published, searchable decisions**; ⭐ the **"Our insight" page `/businesses/resolving-complaint/our-insight` measures 96.3KB with the title "Our insight | Page 1 of 14"** — **a 14-page insight library** (with `/data-insight` measurably resolving to the same page, 96.3KB); the **"Our business homepage" `/businesses` measures 88.2KB**; ⭐ a measured news page title reads **"Financial Ombudsman received 53,600 cases in the first quarter of 2026/27"** — **case volumes are published quarterly, with the figure in the headline**; measured navigation also includes **How we resolve complaints**, **Our governance and funding**, **Annual reports and accounts**, **Consultations**, **Modernising the redress system**, **Strategic plans and budget**, **Our Board of Directors**, **Our Executive Team**, **Our Ombudsmen**, **Data and insight** and **News**, plus a **case studies** section.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "primary material on decided disputes" layer** — the corpus holds [[fca-open-data]] (**complaint volumes reported by firms themselves**, a **regulatory-return basis**), whereas **FOS publishes cases escalated to the ombudsman together with the decisions and reasoning** — **different bases that cannot substitute for one another** (stated explicitly here so readers do not conflate them). **② Case-by-case decisions are directly usable for work on policy wording and claims disputes** — **how a clause is drafted, how a claim is refused, and which way a decision goes** are invisible in aggregate statistics; readable with [[lossratio-r]], [[health-insurance-reserving-handbook]], [[insurance-qa-en]] and [[payer-agent-audit]]. **③ With [[hk-icb]] it forms a "Hong Kong versus UK" contrast in consumer redress** — both handle insurance disputes, but **one is centred on annual statistics and the other on a case-by-case decisions database**, a concrete entry point for **cross-border comparison of consumer-protection strength**. **④ Case volumes are themselves an industry indicator** — **changes in complaint volumes often foreshadow product problems before regulatory penalties do**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **page existence, titles, page sizes, navigation structure and one measured case-volume headline**, **but searched no decisions database, opened no individual decision, and opened no annual report or insight article**, so **no case outcome, reasoning or statistical basis can be restated**; **② the 53,600 figure comes from a measured page title**, and **its scope, basis and whether an insurance breakdown exists were not verified in the body**; **③ whether the decisions database is full-text searchable, what years it covers, and whether it needs payment or login were not verified**; **④** the homepage navigation links a **`complaints.financial-ombudsman.org.uk/ombudsman-dashboard` dashboard**, **which was not opened**, so **this entry does not describe its contents**; **⑤** the path `/businesses/complaints-data` **returned 404 in this check** (**my guessed path was wrong, not a site fault**) — **so this entry does not use that URL**; **⑥** this entry **does not claim FOS provides actuarial tools or insurance pricing data**. **Verification note**: the homepage (200), `/businesses` (88.2KB), `ombudsman-decisions` (86.4KB), `our-insight` (96.3KB, including "Page 1 of 14"), `/data-insight` (96.3KB) and the case-volume news page (title measured) were all measured at HTTP 200; **no decisions database search, decision, annual report, insight article or dashboard was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**FOS（Financial Ombudsman Service，英國金融申訴專員服務）** 是**英國處理金融消費者與機構之間爭議的法定申訴機構**，覆蓋範圍包含保險。本條目補的是**「爭議裁決的公開一手來源」這一形態**：實測池內申訴／爭議側此前**只有 [[hk-icb]]（香港保險投訴局，以投訴個案年報數據為主）**，而 **FOS 提供的是「逐案裁決庫」而非「匯總年報」**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁標題實測 **「Financial Ombudsman Service: Our homepage」**；⭐ **「Ombudsman decisions」頁實測 86.4KB，標題「Ombudsman decisions」**——**公開裁決檢索入口**；⭐ **「Our insight」頁實測 96.3KB，標題「Our insight | Page 1 of 14」**——**洞見文章庫共 14 頁**（`/data-insight` 實測解析到同一頁）；**`/businesses` 實測 88.2KB**；⭐ 新聞頁標題實測 **「Financial Ombudsman received 53,600 cases in the first quarter of 2026/27」**——**按季公布案件量**；導航另含 **How we resolve complaints**、**Annual reports and accounts**、**Consultations**、**Our Ombudsmen**、**Data and insight** 與 **case studies** 欄目。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「爭議裁決一手資料層」**——池內有 [[fca-open-data]]（**機構自報投訴量**，屬**監管申報口徑**），而 **FOS 公布的是「升級到申訴專員並作出裁決」的案件與理由**，**兩者口徑不同、不能互相替代**。**② 「逐案裁決」對做條款與理賠爭議的學生可直接使用**——**條款怎麼寫、理賠怎麼被拒、裁決怎麼站邊**，這些在匯總統計裡看不到（可與 [[lossratio-r]]、[[insurance-qa-en]]、[[payer-agent-audit]] 並讀）。**③ 與 [[hk-icb]] 構成「香港 vs 英國」對照**——**一個以年報統計為主、一個以逐案裁決庫為主**。**④ 案件量本身是行業觀察指標**——**申訴量的變化往往先於監管處罰反映產品問題**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面存在、標題、體量、導航結構與一處案件量標題**，**但未檢索裁決庫、未打開任何裁決書、未打開年報或洞見文章**，故**不能轉述任何個案結論或統計口徑**；**② 53,600 來自頁面標題實測**，**未打開正文核實其範圍與是否含保險拆分**；**③ 裁決庫可否全文檢索、覆蓋年限、是否收費或需登入未核實**；**④ 首頁導航另見儀表盤連結，該連結本次未打開**，故**不描述其內容**；**⑤** 本次嘗試的 `/businesses/complaints-data` **返回 404**（**屬我猜測路徑錯誤，非站點問題**）——**故不使用該 URL**；**⑥** 本詞條**不主張** FOS 提供精算工具或保險定價數據**。**核實說明**：六個 URL 均 HTTP 200 實測；**未檢索裁決庫、未打開裁決書／年報／洞見文章／儀表盤**。
e.verified_note: HTTP 200 实测（首页标题「Financial Ombudsman Service: Our homepage」；/businesses 88.2KB；⭐/businesses/resolving-complaint/ombudsman-decisions 86.4KB 标题「Ombudsman decisions」；⭐/businesses/resolving-complaint/our-insight 96.3KB 标题「Our insight | Page 1 of 14」；/data-insight 96.3KB 解析到同一页；新闻页标题实测「Financial Ombudsman received 53,600 cases in the first quarter of 2026/27」；导航实测含 How we resolve complaints / Annual reports and accounts / Consultations / Modernising the redress system / Our Ombudsmen / Data and insight / case studies）+ ★池内申诉争议侧此前仅 hk-icb（年报统计型），本项目补「逐案裁决库」；/businesses/complaints-data 实测 404（我猜错路径，未使用）；未检索裁决库、未打开裁决书/年报/洞见文章、未打开 ombudsman-dashboard 仪表盘、未核实 53,600 的统计口径
